title: Shin2022: Closed-loop 1D left/right motor imagery EEG dataset (live recordings)
description: A closed-loop EEG dataset of one-dimensional left/right motor imagery cursor control recorded from 10 healthy participants using a 16-channel dry-electrode system. Participants imagined left- or right-hand movement to drive a cursor toward a target under continuous visual feedback, completing 11 runs of 24 trials each while online control parameters were varied. The data support research on sensorimotor rhythm-based brain-computer interfaces and closed-loop decoding.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 250 Hz from 16 dry electrodes (g.tec g.Nautilus RESEARCH with g.SAHARA) using BCI2000. Each subject completed one session of 11 runs with 24 trials per run (12 left, 12 right). Online control used autoregressive spectrum alpha-band power with a Laplacian spatial filter around C3 and C4, with visual cursor feedback.
